name: Hero
description: Full-width carousel with a strong headline. Good for cover slides and product reveals.

name: Tabbed Content
description: Tab bar with multiple content panels. Each panel can hold carousels, tables, or text.

name: Two Column — Compare
description: Left column for a problem/benefit list, right column for supporting visuals. Good for before/after and differentiation slides.

name: Selector + Carousel
description: Tag chips at the top act as a category selector. Each tag reveals a different carousel below. Good for defect types, product variants, or grouped visuals.

name: Carousel + Info Cards
description: Narrow left column for specification cards, wide right column for a carousel. Good for product detail and installation slides.

name: Steps + CTA
description: Numbered process steps with a call-to-action button below. Good for onboarding, contact, and next-steps slides.

name: Partner / Logo Grid
description: Grid of partner or machinery vendor logos. Good for integration, ecosystem, and technology partner slides.

name: Two Column — List + Visual
description: Left column for a feature or checklist, right column for a carousel or single image. Good for quality checks and process overviews.

name: Full Width — Text
description: Single full-width text block. Good for intro slides, legal copy, or any slide that leads with words.

name: KPI Stats Grid
description: 2×2 grid of large stat blocks, each with a value, label, and optional sublabel. Good for company facts and key numbers slides.
